However, the paper explicitly mentions three biological replicates per condition (three DMSO and three RAP). issue_summary.TYPE_CHECK: The value represents technical replicate indices, which is the correct field.
issue_summary.SOURCE_CHECK: The paper states that "Two replicate injections were made for each fraction", implying technical replicates.
issue_summary.TRUTH_CHECK: The mapping assigns a unique index to each run (assay) across different samples. However, technical replicates are repeated runs of the same material. In this dataset, the "source" (Sample 1-20) represents the material. For a given sample, the first time it is run (assay run 1 or run 17) should be replicate 1, the second time (assay run 2 or run 18) should be replicate 2, and so on. The candidate value correctly assigns the same technical replicate index to all samples within a single assay run, and increments that index for subsequent runs of the same samples.
